provenance: Rule 10.3 to 10.6. Transcribed from the data card image described in docs/research/2026-09-07_RV-1_counters_charts.md section 7.1, and checked against the rulebook example in rule 10.6 (8 firepower, adjusted roll 6, result +1 morale check).

Columns are firepower factors. Use the rightmost column that does not exceed the adjusted firepower of the fire group (rule 10.3). Rows are the adjusted dice roll; a roll below 2 uses the row 2 result and a roll above 15 has no effect.
Result codes: KIA eliminates all squads and leaders in the hex (rule 8.8). M is a morale check with no modifier. A number is a morale check with that modifier (rule 12.21). A dash is no effect.
The project writes this table in its own layout (SR-07).

point_blank.note: target hex adjacent to the firing unit

long_range.note: target beyond the printed range and within double range

moving_fire.note: the firing unit moved this player turn

moving_in_open.note: Defensive Fire Phase, units that moved in an open ground target hex
